response.rationale: Both translations correctly express “body temperature,” and the sense is accurate. “Suhu tubuh” is well-attested in Indonesian, while “suhu badan” is standard in Malaysian Malay. The relation “similar” is appropriate. No false-friend contrast is supplied or required; however, neither form should be taught as exclusive to one national variety.
